title: SPADE: Spatiotemporal Preference Alignment and Diversity Enhancement for Local Search
topic: 业务对齐分词与多样性解码
code_status: 固定v1全文及arXiv链接未发现SPADE原作者实现仓库；同名其他项目不是开源证据
code_license: 作者源码未发现；论文arXiv非独占许可；本地独立实现

online_ab.traffic: one-week production A/B vs production baseline, 20% traffic per arm, p<0.05
online_ab.source_location: Section4.8; SearchVolume+0.177%, SearchDAU+0.105%, all p<0.05; paper system evidence only

cost_assessment.available_resource: one NVIDIA A100 or A30, or local Mac
cost_assessment.model_scale: 6-layer decoder, dim512,8heads plus Qwen3-32B independent evaluator; 8 data-center training GPUs
cost_assessment.data_scale: 100K users,1.48M queries,7.79M pretraining and3.08M alignment samples,private GPS/production feedback;3+1 epochs
cost_assessment.estimated_cost_basis: multi-million private samples, multi-GPU training and production query execution/judging exceed a cheap single-device reproduction; exactGPU-hours not disclosed
cost_assessment.decision: 完整实验成本过高，不复现（审查 DONE）；仅CPU OA-BPE局部统计/合并和SDBS外部logp扩展裁剪，不下载模型或日志

summary: OA-BPE用业务价值加权token-pair计数，STAR以软门控编码时空位置，MARS-DPO对齐生产偏好，SDBS按父beam排序给予有界sigmoid奖励。本地只实现分词/解码算子；首beam自身零奖励不意味着任意参数下top1永不被其他beam超过。
